text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the training track, it 
was far more crowded than usual.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My... Could they be visitors from outside? 
There are so many of them.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm alright. Even during the real 
race, I'm quite accustomed to the 
commotion.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Although, personally, I find it much 
easier to concentrate when it's quiet~.

Grass Wonder's running that day seemed to 
lack its usual luster.
